units.source_text: 古歌：“严霜摧草木，不问根与叶。

en.t: An old poem says: Severe frost withers grasses and trees, without asking whether they are roots or leaves.

units.source_text: 短命或长年，一例同消灭。”

en.t: Whether life is short or years are long, all alike vanish and are destroyed.
This appears in the Shin Kokin Wakashu.
